ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of the Autumn 1982 Touch/Throwin’ Stones debut tour with high‑energy performance
ai_review.review: The show captures the excitement of the Fall 1982 “Touch”/“Throwin' Stones” debut tour, delivering a high‑time vibe that fans rave about. Reviewers praise the matrix mix as crystal‑clear and by far the best version available, making both the music and its recording highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review highlights a stellar performance and an excellent matrix recording; limited sample size lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review calls the recording "excellent" and "by far the best," indicating clear, balanced sound with no noted issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Debut of new material (Touch/Throwin' Stones) gave the set fresh momentum and kept energy high throughout.
